 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Five games remain in the calendar year for the Bayern Munich Frauen. Today, it is a UEFA Women's Champions League kickoff against Austria Wien.
 The Bavarians are third in the league phase table currently and coming off a terrific 4-1 blasting of Germany's second-best team, VfL Wolfsburg, while Austria Wien is dead last.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement It will be a joyous reunion for Bayern with long-time mainstay Carina Wenninger (222 appearances from 2007-2023).
 "The fact that we're actually facing Bayern in the Champions League now is wonderful – and, of course, something very special for me personally," Wenninger said (via FCBayern.com ).
 But once the teams take to the pitch, it will be all business. Bayern's UWCL slate does not get easier (next up is FC Barcelona) so this is a game where the German champions simply have to get the expected three points.
 Prediction: Bayern wins 4-0.
 It's Bayern time.
